description.text: The garage is a narrow concrete bay crowded with a toolbench, stacked parts, and an open engine bay at its center. A single work lamp hangs low, pooling amber light over the engine and leaving the corners in oily shadow. Dust and the smell of old grease seem to cling to the close air. The older mechanic straightens from the engine bay, a rag twisted in his hands. He wipes his palms with slow, deliberate pressure, then turns toward the frayed drive belt and jabs a finger at it. His stance stays square to the younger man, his expression hard and impatient, as if the failed belt has just become the whole argument.
Dust hangs in the amber work-lamp light over the open engine bay, where the concrete floor is dark with old oil and the toolbench is crowded against the wall.
A low garage room tone hums beneath the scene.
The older mechanic straightens from the engine bay and wipes his hands on a rag.
The rag rasps across his palms.
He jabs a finger toward the frayed drive belt and holds the younger mechanic's gaze.
The belt creaks faintly as the engine settles.

The younger mechanic leans over the engine, his face half in shadow and his hands braced on the cold metal. The cramped garage seems tighter around the two men, tools and parts pressing in at the edges of the lamp's reach. He shakes his head, then taps two fingers against the belt housing, testing the same frayed spot the older man has just condemned. The small metal sound cuts through the room tone. He straightens enough to hold the older man's stare, his chin lifted and his shoulders set, refusing to step back. The space between them narrows as the argument settles into a stubborn standoff.
The younger mechanic leans over the engine, his face half in shadow and his hands braced on the cold metal.
Garage room tone continues under the close, enclosed space.
He shakes his head and taps the belt housing with two fingers.
Metal ticks under his knuckles, and a distant tool clinks.
He straightens enough to hold the older man's stare, refusing to step back.
The engine ticks as the room tone presses close around them.

soundscape: Cramped garage room tone, rag rasp, belt creak, fingers tapping metal, and a distant tool clink.
